pageDescription: FAS Expedition – Career opportunities at FAS Expedition. Join our team in Lammersdorf.

hero.title: Careers
hero.subtitle: Join the team! We're constantly looking for reinforcements for our young team.

intro:
FAS Expedition GmbH is a young company in the expedition vehicle market. With our two main divisions "Vehicle Construction" and "Cabin Construction", we offer our customers an off-road capable world-travel vehicle from a single source.

If you share our passion for travel or can imagine being part of the world of expedition vehicles — check our current openings below. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Caravan / Motorhome Technician (m/f/d)
tasks: Interior construction of premium expedition vehicles
Routing and connection of electrical, water, heating, and climate systems
Installation of solar systems, TV, WiFi infrastructure, and appliances
Fitting additional equipment such as exterior lighting, camera systems, alarm systems, step systems, and outdoor kitchens
profile: Passion for visual and functional perfection with premium materials
Experience with the technical infrastructure of motorhomes
Vocational training in caravan, electrical, installation technology, commercial vehicle electronics, or boat building
benefits: Reporting to the Cabin Construction Team Lead

jobs.title: Commercial Vehicle Technician / Mechatronics Technician (m/f/d)
tasks: Installation, wiring, and commissioning of on-board electrical systems (24V)
Electrical preparation and installation of add-on components such as lighting, camera systems, winches, and tire pressure control systems
Setup and programming of control and monitoring systems such as CAN bus, ECUs, and cabin interfaces
Support with mechanical disassembly and assembly work on items such as subframes, rear carriers, storage boxes, tank systems, roof racks, and more
profile: Passion for commercial vehicles and clean cable routing
Solid knowledge of vehicle electrics and electronics
Experience working with wiring diagrams and diagnostic systems as well as manufacturer-specific vehicle information systems and web portals for sourcing original spare parts
Vocational training in body or vehicle construction, preferably in the commercial vehicle segment with a focus on electrics/electronics
Good communication skills and team spirit
benefits: Reporting to the Vehicle Construction Workshop Manager
